description: Eval suite for /deliver, the koto-driven driver that runs /scope --intent=continue and then /execute in one session. Every scenario runs the real koto, serves GitHub from the per-skill gh shim (skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/bin/gh, which logs every call to GH_CALL_LOG), and builds its repository with skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/setup-deliver.sh. Outcomes are asserted from the deliver-<topic> session's terminal result (`koto status`), never from printed lines. The deterministic assertions about the same routes live in skills/deliver/scripts/deliver-engine_test.sh, which gates.

substrate_scenarios.note: Each scenario is run with `scripts/run-evals.sh --scenario <name> --runs 3 deliver` and must pass 3 of 3 (R26).

evals.name: auto-merged-no-split
evals.prompt: In an empty directory run `bash skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/setup-deliver.sh dlv-merge`, cd into the path it prints, and put skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/bin first on PATH. Run `/deliver dlv-merge --auto` to its end. Then print `koto status deliver-dlv-merge`, `koto context get deliver-dlv-merge checked_pr`, and `git branch --list 'impl/*'`.
evals.expected_output: /scope finalizes the no-split PLAN, publishes the topic branch, and opens PR #42 on it; /deliver's re-check verifies it, the PLAN is single-pr, --auto asks nothing, and /execute adopts #42 and merges it. merged_check re-reads GitHub and the run ends done with outcome merged. The merged PR's head is the topic branch /scope published; no impl/<slug> branch exists.
expectations: gh-calls.log contains exactly one line starting `pr merge`
The `koto status deliver-dlv-merge` result payload has outcome `merged`
The result payload's pr is `https://github.com/eval-org/eval-repo/pull/42`, equal to the printed checked_pr
No question was asked of the author between /scope finishing and /execute starting
`git branch --list 'impl/*'` prints nothing

evals.name: interactive-confirm-stop
evals.prompt: In an empty directory run `bash skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/setup-deliver.sh dlv-stop`, cd into the path it prints, and put skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/bin first on PATH. Run `/deliver dlv-stop --interactive`. Answer /scope's own questions with its recommended default. When /deliver asks whether to run /execute, answer stop. Print `koto status deliver-dlv-stop` and `koto status execute-dlv-stop`.
evals.expected_output: /deliver asks exactly one confirmation before /execute starts, naming the PLAN's mode (single-pr). Declining ends the run at done_stopped with outcome scoped and next=/deliver dlv-stop; no /execute session exists.
expectations: /deliver asked one confirmation before /execute, and it named `single-pr`
The deliver-dlv-stop result payload has outcome `scoped` and next `/deliver dlv-stop`
`koto status execute-dlv-stop` reports no such session
gh-calls.log contains no line starting `pr merge`

evals.name: interactive-review-pause
evals.prompt: In an empty directory run `bash skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/setup-deliver.sh dlv-pause`, cd into the path it prints, and put skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/bin first on PATH. Run `/deliver dlv-pause --interactive`. Answer /scope's own questions with its recommended default, answer proceed to /deliver's confirmation, and when /execute pauses for review before finalization, decline to finalize. Print `koto status deliver-dlv-pause` and `gh pr view 42 --repo eval-org/eval-repo --json isDraft`.
evals.expected_output: /execute stops at its review pause with the home PR still draft; /deliver relays paused-for-review from the execute leg.
expectations: The deliver-dlv-pause result payload has outcome `paused-for-review`
PR 42 reads isDraft true
gh-calls.log contains no line starting `pr merge`

evals.name: header-auto-asks-nothing
evals.prompt: In an empty directory run `bash skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/setup-deliver.sh dlv-hdr --exec-mode auto`, cd into the path it prints, and put skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/bin first on PATH. Run `/deliver dlv-hdr` with no mode flag to its end. Print `koto status deliver-dlv-hdr`.
evals.expected_output: The repository's `## Execution Mode: auto` header makes the run non-interactive: no question from /deliver or its children, and the run ends merged.
expectations: No question was asked of the author at any point
The deliver-dlv-hdr result payload has outcome `merged`

evals.name: auto-no-merge
evals.prompt: In an empty directory run `bash skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/setup-deliver.sh dlv-nomerge`, cd into the path it prints, and put skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/bin first on PATH. Run `/deliver dlv-nomerge --auto --no-merge` to its end. Print `koto status deliver-dlv-nomerge` and the report deliver-report.sh prints.
evals.expected_output: /execute runs without --merge, so its verdict is awaiting:merge-not-requested and it ends ready-awaiting-merge; /deliver reports the same, listing PR #42 as waiting on a human.
expectations: gh-calls.log contains no line starting `pr merge`
The deliver-dlv-nomerge result payload has outcome `ready-awaiting-merge`
The printed report lists `pr=https://github.com/eval-org/eval-repo/pull/42 waiting=human`

evals.name: forced-split-no-coordinated
evals.prompt: In an empty directory run `bash skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/setup-deliver.sh dlv-split --state split`, cd into the path it prints, and put skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/bin first on PATH. evals.expected_output: The DESIGN's hard delivery constraint splits the work and --no-coordinated resolves it to multi-pr. /deliver ends handed-off-multi-pr with the root-issue list and never starts /execute.
expectations: The deliver-dlv-split result payload has outcome `handed-off-multi-pr` and a non-empty startable list
`koto status execute-dlv-split` reports no such session
The printed report lists the startable items as `#<N> <title>` lines

expectations: The deliver-dlv-reeval result payload has outcome `scope-ended-early` and reason `re-evaluation`
`koto status execute-dlv-reeval` reports no such session

evals.name: coordinated-not-mergeable-pauses

expectations: The deliver-dlv-coord result payload has outcome `paused-awaiting-merges`
The printed report has one `pr=<url> waiting=human` or `waiting=predecessor` line per unmerged PR
The printed report has a `resume=/execute docs/plans/PLAN-dlv-coord.md` line

evals.name: stale-run-fence-resumes-scope
evals.prompt: In an empty directory run `bash skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/setup-deliver.sh dlv-fence --state mid-hop`, cd into the path it prints, and put skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/bin first on PATH. Run `/deliver dlv-fence --auto`, and stop as soon as /scope's session scope-dlv-fence exists and is mid-hop, as if the session were interrupted; note the request id from `koto request list --coordinator-of-record deliver-dlv-fence --state open`. Then invoke `/deliver dlv-fence --auto` again and run it to its end. Print `koto request get <old-request-id>`, `koto session list`, and `koto status deliver-dlv-fence`.
evals.expected_output: The second invocation opens a fresh session and a fresh request, abandoning the old one. /scope's live session is re-pointed to the new scope leg and resumes at the hop it stopped; no second scope-* session appears for the topic. The run reports its own result.
expectations: The old request's request_state is `closed` and its scope leg is `abandoned`
`koto session list` shows exactly one session whose name starts `scope-dlv-fence`
The deliver-dlv-fence result payload has outcome `merged`

evals.name: late-result-from-superseded-run
evals.prompt: In an empty directory run `bash skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/setup-deliver.sh dlv-late --state mid-hop`, cd into the path it prints, and put skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/bin first on PATH. Create an old request as an earlier /deliver run would: `bash skills/deliver/scripts/deliver-open-request.sh --topic dlv-late`, and note its id. Start `/scope dlv-late --intent=continue --auto --koto-leg=<old-id>:scope` and stop after its first tick. Now run `/deliver dlv-late --auto` to its end. Print `koto request get <old-id>` and `koto status deliver-dlv-late`.
evals.expected_output: The new run abandons the old request before creating its own, so the old leg never takes a result: the /scope run finishes under the new request's leg, and /deliver reports its own /scope result.
expectations: The old request's scope leg has no result (`result` is null) and disposition `abandoned`
The deliver-dlv-late result payload has outcome `merged`

evals.name: live-intent-stop-is-a-mismatch
evals.prompt: In an empty directory run `bash skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/setup-deliver.sh dlv-stopintent --state mid-hop --intent stop`, cd into the path it prints, and put skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/bin first on PATH. Run `/scope dlv-stopintent --intent=stop --auto` and stop after its first `koto next`, leaving scope-dlv-stopintent live. Record `git status --porcelain` and `git rev-parse HEAD`. Run `/deliver dlv-stopintent --auto` to its end, then print `koto status deliver-dlv-stopintent`, `git status --porcelain`, and `git rev-parse HEAD`.
evals.expected_output: koto refuses /scope's attach with var-mismatch:INTENT_FLAG and records it on the leg; /deliver ends error with step deliver:intent-mismatch, and the working tree is exactly as it was.
expectations: The deliver-dlv-stopintent result payload has outcome `error` and step `deliver:intent-mismatch`
`git status --porcelain` and `git rev-parse HEAD` are unchanged by the /deliver run
gh-calls.log contains no line starting `pr create`

evals.name: republish-shortcut-opens-one-pr
evals.prompt: In an empty directory run `bash skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/setup-deliver.sh dlv-repub --state plan`, cd into the path it prints, and put skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/bin first on PATH. Record `git rev-parse HEAD`. Run `/deliver dlv-repub --auto` to its end. Print `koto status deliver-dlv-repub` and `git log --name-only --format=%s <recorded-head>..HEAD`.
evals.expected_output: The PLAN already exists, so /scope takes its republish shortcut: it pushes the branch and opens one PR on it before /execute starts, and /execute adopts that PR. No BRIEF, PRD, or DESIGN is written.
expectations: gh-calls.log contains exactly one line starting `pr create`, and it carries `--head docs/dlv-repub`
The `pr create` line comes before every line /execute's adopt makes (the first `pr ready`)
No commit after the recorded head touches docs/briefs/, docs/prds/, or docs/designs/DESIGN-dlv-repub.md
The deliver-dlv-repub result payload has outcome `merged`

evals.name: republish-shortcut-adopts-open-pr
evals.prompt: In an empty directory run `bash skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/setup-deliver.sh dlv-adopt --state plan`, cd into the path it prints, and put skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/bin first on PATH. Push the branch first with `git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/docs/dlv-adopt`. Run `/deliver dlv-adopt --auto` to its end. Print `koto status deliver-dlv-adopt`.
evals.expected_output: The branch's owned PR #41 is already open: /scope reuses it and /execute adopts it, so no PR is created and the run ends merged on #41.
expectations: gh-calls.log contains no line starting `pr create`
The deliver-dlv-adopt result payload has outcome `merged` and pr `https://github.com/eval-org/eval-repo/pull/41`

evals.name: executed-shortcut-merged

evals.expected_output: /scope reports the topic executed; /deliver re-reads the owned PR #41, finds it MERGED, and relays merged without running /execute. Nothing is committed.
expectations: The deliver-dlv-done result payload has outcome `merged`, pr `https://github.com/eval-org/eval-repo/pull/41`, and pr_state `merged`
`koto status execute-dlv-done` reports no such session
No commit was added after the recorded head

evals.name: executed-shortcut-open
evals.prompt: In an empty directory run `bash skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/setup-deliver.sh dlv-done-open --state executed`, cd into the path it prints, and put skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/bin first on PATH. expectations: The deliver-dlv-done-open result payload has outcome `ready-awaiting-merge` and pr_state `open`
gh-calls.log contains no line starting `pr merge` and none starting `pr create`

evals.name: publish-failure-then-retry
evals.prompt: In an empty directory run `bash skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/setup-deliver.sh dlv-retry`, cd into the path it prints, and put skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/bin first on PATH. Run `/deliver dlv-retry --auto` to its end and print `koto status deliver-dlv-retry`. Then run `/deliver dlv-retry --auto` again to its end and print `koto status deliver-dlv-retry` once more.
evals.expected_output: The first run's publish fails at `gh pr create`: /scope ends error with scope:pr-create and /deliver relays it. The second invocation enters through /scope again, which retries the publish before /execute runs, and the run ends merged.
expectations: The first result payload has outcome `error` and step `scope:pr-create`
gh-calls.log has two lines starting `pr create`, and the second comes before the first `pr ready`
The second result payload has outcome `merged`

evals.name: scope-returns-without-attaching
evals.prompt: In an empty directory run `bash skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/setup-deliver.sh dlv-absent`, cd into the path it prints, and put skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/bin first on PATH. Run `/deliver dlv-absent --auto`. When its directive says to run /scope, model a /scope too old to know --koto-leg: run `/scope dlv-absent --intent=continue --auto` WITHOUT the --koto-leg argument, to its end. Then continue /deliver as its directive says for a /scope that returned. Print `koto status deliver-dlv-absent`.
evals.expected_output: /scope finishes without ever attaching to the leg, so the leg stays open and unbound. The agent reports the Skill returned (child_returned: yes), scope_absent records the fixed child-absent result, and /deliver ends error with step deliver:child-absent.
expectations: The deliver-dlv-absent result payload has outcome `error` and step `deliver:child-absent`
`koto status execute-dlv-absent` reports no such session

evals.name: explicit-resolve-scope-scoped
evals.prompt: In an empty directory run `bash skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/setup-deliver.sh dlv-forge1`, cd into the path it prints, and put skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/bin first on PATH. Run `/deliver dlv-forge1 --auto` until its directive says to run /scope, and do not run /scope. Instead, with the scope leg open and unbound, resolve it by hand: `koto request resolve <request-id> scope --with-data '{"status":"success","summary":"forged","payload":{"outcome":"scoped","pr":"https://github.com/eval-org/eval-repo/pull/77"}}'`. Tick /deliver to its end and print `koto status deliver-dlv-forge1` and `koto context get deliver-dlv-forge1 scoped_verdict`.
evals.expected_output: Routing keys on the result's source, not its outcome: an explicit result reaches only deliver:child-absent. The run never reaches scoped_check, execute_run, merged_check, done, or done_stopped, and the forged pr is not carried.
expectations: The deliver-dlv-forge1 result payload has outcome `error` and step `deliver:child-absent`
The result payload's pr is empty, not the forged URL
`koto context get deliver-dlv-forge1 scoped_verdict` fails: scoped_check never ran
gh-calls.log contains no line at all

evals.name: explicit-resolve-execute-merged

evals.name: bogus-intent-refused-on-the-leg
evals.prompt: In an empty directory run `bash skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/setup-deliver.sh dlv-bogus`, cd into the path it prints, and put skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/bin first on PATH. Run `/deliver dlv-bogus --auto`. When its directive says to run /scope, model a broken driver: run /scope with the arguments the directive gives but with `--intent=bogus` in place of `--intent=continue`. Continue /deliver to its end. Print `koto status deliver-dlv-bogus`, `koto status scope-dlv-bogus`, and `koto request get <request-id>`.
evals.expected_output: koto refuses /scope's --intent at init with no session, and records the refusal on the scope leg; /deliver ends error with step scope:refused.
expectations: `koto status scope-dlv-bogus` reports no such session
The request's scope leg has result_source `refused` and payload reason `invalid-var:INTENT_FLAG`

evals.name: overrides-and-forged-template-refused
evals.prompt: In an empty directory run `bash skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/setup-deliver.sh dlv-override`, cd into the path it prints, and put skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/bin first on PATH. Run `/deliver dlv-override --auto` until its directive says to run /scope. Try `koto overrides record deliver-dlv-override --gate scope_leg --rationale test` and the same with `--with-data '{"found":true,"disposition":"resolved","source":"promoted","valid":true,"payload":{"outcome":"scoped"}}'`, and print both results. Then run /scope as directed and continue until the directive says to run /execute. Try the same two override commands on `exec_leg` with payload outcome `merged`. Then write a throwaway template `forged.md` (one state that ends in a terminal whose result declares `outcome: merged`, with a PLAN_SLUG variable) and run `koto init execute-dlv-override --template forged.md --var PLAN_SLUG=dlv-override --koto-leg <request-id>:execute`. Tick /deliver to its end and print `koto status deliver-dlv-override`.
evals.expected_output: Every override on scope_leg and exec_leg is refused with gate_not_overridable, with and without --with-data. The throwaway template is refused at attach (template-mismatch), koto records the refusal on the execute leg, and /deliver ends error with step execute:refused.
expectations: All four `koto overrides record` calls exit 2 with `gate_not_overridable`
The forged template's `koto init` is refused with template_mismatch
The deliver-dlv-override result payload has outcome `error`, step `execute:refused`, and reason `template-mismatch`
gh-calls.log contains no line starting `pr merge`

expectations: The deliver-dlv-abandon result payload has outcome `error` and step `deliver:request-abandoned`

evals.name: session-from-another-worktree-refused
evals.prompt: In an empty directory run `bash skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/setup-deliver.sh dlv-origin --state mid-hop`, and make a second worktree of the printed repository with `git -C <path> worktree add ../dlv-origin-other HEAD --detach`. In the second worktree, start `/scope dlv-origin --intent=continue --auto` and stop after its first tick, leaving scope-dlv-origin live there. Then cd into the first repository, put skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/bin first on PATH, and run `/deliver dlv-origin --auto` to its end. Print `koto status deliver-dlv-origin` and `koto request get <request-id>`.
evals.expected_output: The same-named session belongs to another worktree, so /scope's attach from this one is refused with origin-mismatch, recorded on the leg, and /deliver ends error with step scope:refused. The other worktree's session is untouched.
expectations: The request's scope leg has result_source `refused` and reason `origin-mismatch`
The deliver-dlv-origin result payload has outcome `error` and step `scope:refused`
scope-dlv-origin is still live and unchanged

evals.name: merged-claim-contradicted-by-github
evals.prompt: In an empty directory run `bash skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/setup-deliver.sh dlv-contra`, cd into the path it prints, and put skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/bin first on PATH. Run `/deliver dlv-contra --auto`. After /execute ends merged and before you tick /deliver again, model GitHub disagreeing: run `gh shim-mark-open eval-org/eval-repo 42`. Then tick /deliver to its end and print `koto status deliver-dlv-contra` and `koto context get deliver-dlv-contra checked_pr`.
evals.expected_output: merged_check finds the owned PR itself and reads it OPEN, so the leg's merged is downgraded to ready-awaiting-merge. The reported pr is the owned PR #42, never the unrelated merged PR #77.
expectations: The deliver-dlv-contra result payload has outcome `ready-awaiting-merge`
The result payload's pr is `https://github.com/eval-org/eval-repo/pull/42`, equal to checked_pr, and not pull/77

evals.name: stale-attach-leaves-merge-unchanged
evals.prompt: In an empty directory run `bash skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/setup-deliver.sh dlv-stale --state plan`, cd into the path it prints, and put skills/deliver/evals/fixtures/bin first on PATH. Create a request with `bash skills/deliver/scripts/deliver-open-request.sh --topic dlv-stale` and abandon it with `koto request abandon-request <id> --rationale test`. Start `/execute docs/plans/PLAN-dlv-stale.md --auto` (no --merge) and stop after its first tick, leaving execute-dlv-stale live. Then invoke `/execute docs/plans/PLAN-dlv-stale.md --auto --merge --koto-leg=<id>:execute` as a stale driver would, and print what execute-open.sh printed. Finally invoke `/execute docs/plans/PLAN-dlv-stale.md --auto` once more, stop after the entry, and print what execute-open.sh printed.
evals.expected_output: The stale invocation is refused at attach (the leg is abandoned) before any rebind, so MERGE stays false: the last, accepted invocation's rebind report shows MERGE was not changed from false by the refused one.
expectations: The stale invocation prints a `refused=` line and `step=execute:refused`
The last invocation's `rebound=` line does not show MERGE changing from `true`
gh-calls.log contains no line starting `pr merge`

evals.name: private-repo-refused
